claims.claim: Kane was the bookmakers' favourite for the 2026 Ballon d'Or; ceremony 26 Oct 2026 in London
claims.note: Sky: 'the bookmakers' favourite to be crowned'; 'The 70th Ballon d'Or ceremony will take place on October 26, 2026 in London'. No odds quoted, as the page says.

claims.claim: The 2026 ceremony is the first held outside Paris
claims.note: FA: 'held outside of Paris for the first time'.

claims.claim: 36 Bundesliga goals in 2025/26 including a hat-trick in a 5-1 win over Cologne on Matchday 34
claims.note: Bundesliga report gives 36 goals, a treble in a 5-1 home win over Cologne on Matchday 34.

claims.claim: Bundesliga report dated 16 May 2026: first player to win the top scorer award in each of his first three seasons; Lewandowski only other player with three in a row
claims.note: Both sentences quoted in the report; date 16.05.2026.

claims.claim: FA profile: 36 Bundesliga goals in 31 league games, 100 Bayern goals in 104 competitive games, European Golden Shoe, third straight top-scorer award
claims.note: All four items quoted in the FA profile.

claims.claim: FA credits his Bayern form with 'extraordinary scoring' and says accumulated points decide the prizes
claims.note: Both phrases appear in the FA profile.

claims.claim: Bayern signed Kane from Tottenham in August 2023, club-record deal, four-year contract, Bayern were German champions
claims.note: TNT: 'signed a four-year contract'; 'club-record deal for the German champions'. The article is dated 12/08/2023; it does not spell out the month in the text, so August rests on that date.

claims.claim: Potential fee of EUR 120 million (GBP 104m), and the previous Bayern record EUR 80m (GBP 68m) for Lucas Hernandez from Atletico Madrid in 2019
claims.note: TNT: 'a potential EUR 120 million (GBP 104m) fee'; 'previous record EUR 80m (GBP 68m) they spent on Lucas Hernandez from Atletico Madrid in 2019'.

claims.claim: Tottenham 2019 article: 25 goals in 40 caps for England
claims.note: The figure appears in the article's list entry 'HARRY KANE - 25 goals in 40 caps'.

claims.claim: Tottenham 2022 feature: Jimmy Greaves' 266 Spurs goals was the record he was chasing
claims.note: 'Jimmy Greaves' 266 at Spurs' is quoted.

claims.claim: Debut against Lithuania in March 2015, scored 79 seconds after coming off the bench
claims.note: 'scored 79 seconds after coming off the bench against Lithuania in March, 2015'.

claims.claim: Hodgson: 5 goals in 16 games; Southgate: 61 in 81; 25 goals in 34 games at Wembley (record)
claims.note: All figures quoted.

claims.note: Quoted: 'only the second player to score 50 goals for England' and 'moved above ... Bobby Charlton (49 goals)'.

valueNote: Joins the FA, Bundesliga, Sky and TNT material with the August 2026 extension status, which the general top results do not set out in one place, and states plainly what the sources do not confirm.
summary: All cited claims in this pt page were checked against the opened sources (same claims as the English page, translated) and match. The corrections made during this review (FA 70th-ceremony attribution, unsupported single-manager sentence, uncited 2018 sentence, unsupported shortlist sentence in de) are fixed. No birth facts are stated because no opened source gives them.
